selection_method: Development-only 5-fold GroupKFold CV creates a top-2 shortlist by Macro F1 mean and standard deviation. Repeated development-only GroupShuffleSplit stability then selects the architecture by highest mean validation Macro F1, with lower mean train-validation gap as the tie-break.
